criteria.reasoning: The chart's lead tier row reads "$2,000,000 | 1 | $2,000,000 | $2,000,000", one gift equal to 20% of the $10,000,000 goal. No other lead amount appears.

The chart has exactly four named tiers ($2,000,000 x 1, $1,000,000 x 2, $500,000 x 4, $250,000 x 8) and then an "All other gifts | many" line. No tier below $250,000 is charted, and none of the April draft's tiers are used.
The cumulative totals are $2,000,000, $4,000,000, $6,000,000 and $8,000,000. The All other gifts line is "$2,000,000 | $10,000,000", not reduced by booked commitments.

Section 2 credits "$1,000,000 tier — 1 gift in hand: Hollis Family Foundation" and "$250,000 tier — 1 gift in hand: Ruth and Anders Lindqvist ... $300,000". It also says "P-103 and P-115 therefore are excluded from Section 3", and they are listed under prospects not counted.

Abernathy-Kim is listed under the $500,000 tier's prospects identified as "Verbal $500,000 intention only, counted as a prospect per section 2.3". The $500,000 tier still shows 0 gifts in hand and 4 gifts still needed.
Achebe-Lowry, Ashworth and the Haraways are all listed as "Inclination N (none), excluded". Lucien Park (L) is counted at $500,000, and the Petrakises (L) and the Satos (L) are counted at $250,000.
Rourke, Delacroix-Benn, the Petrakises and Beaumont Hardware Co. (all rating 5) are each "placed at $250,000". The deliverable explains that "$500,000 is above the $400,000 bottom".
The $2,000,000 row shows prospects needed 3, identified 1 and gap 2. The single prospect counted is the Castellane Foundation.
The $1,000,000 row shows 1 gift in hand, 1 still needed, 3 prospects needed, 2 identified (Thornbury, Salcedo) and gap 1. All five figures match the criterion.
The $500,000 row shows 0 in hand, 4 still needed, 16 needed, 4 identified (Voss, Abernathy-Kim, Park, Oduya) and gap 12. All figures match the criterion.

The $250,000 row reads "$250,000 | 8 | $2,000,000 | $8,000,000 | 1 | 1 | 28 | 7 | 21", so gifts still needed is 1 rather than the required 7. Prospects needed (28), identified (7) and gap (21) are correct, but the criterion fails if any of its figures differs, and nowhere else does the deliverable state 7 gifts still needed.
Section 4 lists "1. $250,000 tier — gap 21", "2. $500,000 tier — gap 12" and "3. $2,000,000 tier — gap 2". The $1,000,000 tier is noted separately as the remaining tier, not ranked among the three.

Every prospect and donor named appears in the pipeline or the commitments log, with the ratings and inclination codes shown there (e.g. P-109 Lucien Park rating 4 L, P-118 Quintero rating 6 H). The pledge amounts ($1,000,000, $300,000, $150,000, $86,500) match the commitments log.
